$comment: THE PROVIDERS THIS ENGINE KNOWS. Data, not code: preflight validates a PRD's aiProvider against `known`, and nothing in the pipeline carries a vendor name as a literal. Adding a provider is an edit here and nowhere else. Extracted from preflight-check.sh on 2026-08-16, where the same set lived as a Python set literal inside an embedded program — a place no other check could read and no one would think to update.
$effortBadgeComment: Providers whose viewer badge is driven by the effort tier, so effort=low renders as the cheapest badge. Preflight warns when a story on one of these is assigned effort=low, because the badge then misreports the model actually doing the work.
$modelRulesComment: Per-provider rules about the MODEL a story may be assigned. `requiresSlug` means the model must be a routed slug carrying a '/' — an assignment without one names a model the router cannot reach, and the story fails with an empty result rather than a routing error. `knownModels` is advisory: an unlisted model warns, because a new model appearing is normal and a typo looks the same. Absent from this map means no rule.

minimax.$suitabilityComment: Test-authoring drifted on this provider (see the brownfield test-authoring incident): it rewrites the assertions instead of writing the test the criterion asks for. A story whose files are test files must not be assigned to it.

$statusComment: The story statuses a PRD may carry. Preflight rejects anything else — an unexpected status is read as not-completed by every gate, so a typo silently fails a story that succeeded.
$cliBinaryComment: The CLI binary provider_to_cli() (claude.sh) runs for a given aiProvider. A literal binary name means that vendor has its own dedicated runner script; the sentinel "$EPAM_CLI" means it runs through the epam CLI itself (the shared runner for providers without a standalone script — openai/openrouter/cursor/minimax all resolve to the same $EPAM_CLI value, which defaults to "epam" but is overridable). Every key here MUST also appear in `known` — see $knownDrift.
$knownDrift: known must match the list provider_to_cli() ADVERTISES in its own error message — that is the engine's statement of what a PRD may assign. 'epam' was removed 2026-08-25: it is a vestigial case arm mapping to $EPAM_CLI, the same target as copilot/openai/openrouter/cursor/minimax, it names the RUNNER rather than a vendor, nothing assigns it, and the engine does not advertise it. codemie-claude and copilot were ADDED for the opposite reason: both are advertised and accepted, and preflight would have rejected a PRD assigning them. 'anthropic', 'claude' and 'gemini' were removed the same day for the INVERSE reason: they were listed with no case arm at all, so a PRD assigning them passed the gate and died at runtime. brownfield-test-prd.json already assigned "claude" and would have failed mid-run; it now fails at preflight, before anything is spent.
$cliBinaryCopilot: 2026-09-27: copilot runs the GitHub Copilot CLI (`copilot`), not $EPAM_CLI. The engine calls the copilot runner plugin (plugins/providers/copilot/runner.sh, declared in runnerPlugin); the $EPAM_CLI route reached epam-cli's HTTP CopilotProvider, which has no tool calling. COPILOT_CMD overrides the binary (tests point it at a recording wrapper).
$cliBinaryCodemieWeb: 2026-09-28: codemie-web runs CodeMie web assistants through the CodeMie CLI's own authenticated client (plugins/providers/codemie-web/); the binary it needs on PATH is `codemie`. The installer's runner check reads this map, so a runner whose name is not its binary is still checked for the binary it needs.
$runnerPlugin: Providers whose calls need vendor facts (a CLI's flags, an SDK's layout, a service's protocol) are PLUGINS: this names each one's directory (relative to orchestrations/), whose runner.sh defines provider_call and, optionally, provider_stop (lib/provider-plugin.sh). The seam hub, the story writer, the orchestrator's dispatch and the run's exit handler read this — no engine file names a plugin provider. Adding one is this line and a directory (review of 2026-09-29).
